title: Exact spectral integrability of a finite-channel random Schr\"odinger operator: from fermionization of the Dyson--Riccati gas to Kontsevich integral
summary: We solve exactly, for arbitrary finite channel number $N$, the Riccati dynamics of a quasi-one-dimensional random matrix Schr\"odinger operator with Hermitian white-noise potential in the $\beta=2$ unitary symmetry class. The associated Dyson--Riccati eigenvalue gas admits an exact free-fermion representation at any sample length $L$, which in the limit $L\to \infty$ expresses the density of states and the total Lyapunov growth rate exactly through a single Airy Hankel $\tau$-function providing multichannel generalization of $N=1$ Halperin--Thouless formulas. The $\tau-$function further admits an outgoing-contour Kontsevich matrix Airy integral representation. Its saddle-point and double-scaling analyses give, in a unified way, the finite-channel density Lifshitz tail, and the large-$N$ spectral edge. In particular, for $N\gg 1$ the sharp $N=\infty$ edge is softened within an $N^{-4/5}$ spectral window, with its profile governed by the tritronqu\'ee solution of Painlev\'e I. We conjecture universality of this quasi-one-dimensional scaling edge profile for a broad class of $\beta=2$ random band matrices.

AI.tldr: 该文对任意有限通道数 N 的 quasi-1D β=2 随机矩阵 Schrödinger 算子精确求解 Riccati 动力学，用单个 Airy Hankel τ 函数表达态密度与 Lyapunov 增长率，并统一得到有限通道 Lifshitz 尾及大 N 谱边软化；大 N 谱边在 N^{-4/5} 窗口内由 Painlevé I 的 tritronquée 解描述，并猜想其对 β=2 随机带矩阵具有普适性。
AI.motivation: 将 N=1 的 Halperin--Thouless 公式推广到多通道 quasi-1D 无序系统，统一刻画有限通道密度尾与大 N 谱边，并探索 β=2 随机带矩阵的普适谱边标度。
AI.method: 在任意样本长度 L 下将 Dyson--Riccati 本征气体表述为精确自由费米子问题；L→∞ 时用单个 Airy Hankel τ 函数求态密度和总 Lyapunov 增长率；进一步给出 outgoing-contour Kontsevich 矩阵 Airy 积分表示，并用鞍点与双标度分析处理有限通道和大 N 极限。
AI.result: 得到多通道 DOS 与总 Lyapunov 增长率的精确 τ 函数表达式；统一导出有限通道密度 Lifshitz 尾和大 N 谱边。对 N≫1，尖锐的 N=∞ 谱边在 N^{-4/5} 谱窗内软化，其剖面由 Painlevé I 的 tritronquée 解支配。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出 quasi-1D β=2 随机 Schrödinger 算子的精确多通道理论，并 conjectures 该 N^{-4/5} 谱边剖面在一大类 β=2 随机带矩阵中具有普适性。

title: Moments of Random Permanents and Hafnians: A Replica Approach
summary: Using contour-integral representations of the permanent and of the Hafnian, we turn the computation of their moments for random matrices into a replica calculation, analogous to that of the moments of the partition function of a mean-field spin glass. For the $2k$-th moment of $N\times N$ matrices with independent entries, the dominant saddle point is replica symmetric for $k>2$, and we obtain in closed form the exponential growth rate, the prefactor and the first $1/N$ correction, in agreement with exact enumerations. The growth rate depends only on whether the entries are real or complex; higher cumulants affect only the prefactor and the $1/N$ term. At $k=2$ the replica-symmetric solution becomes unstable, separating a power-law bulk of the distribution from a large-deviation tail, which we compute. The results apply to boson sampling with single photons and with squeezed light.

AI.tldr: 利用永久式与Hafnian的围道积分表示，将随机矩阵矩的计算转化为类似平均场自旋玻璃配分函数矩的replica计算，得到闭式渐近结果并揭示k=2处的稳定性转变；结果适用于单光子与压缩光玻色采样。
AI.motivation: 为理解随机矩阵永久式/Hafnian矩的统计行为及其在玻色采样中的应用，需要一种可系统计算高阶矩、指数增长率、前因子和有限N修正的解析框架。
AI.method: 用永久式和Hafnian的围道积分表示，把N×N独立元素随机矩阵的2k阶矩写成replica配分函数型计算，并用鞍点法分析主导鞍点的replica对称性。
AI.result: 当k>2时主导鞍点为replica对称，得到指数增长率、前因子及首个1/N修正的闭式表达，并与精确枚举吻合；增长率仅取决于元素为实数或复数，更高累积量只影响前因子和1/N项。k=2时replica对称解失稳，区分出幂律主体分布与大偏差尾部，并给出尾部计算。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了随机矩阵永久式/Hafnian矩的统一解析方法，刻画了k=2处的统计转变，并直接关联到单光子和压缩光玻色采样的相关统计问题。

title: Ubiquitous Flat Bands in Edge-Inflated Random Graphs
summary: Flat bands are usually associated with periodic lattice geometries, where destructive interference or chiral-symmetry constraints produce macroscopically degenerate eigenstates. Here we show that flat bands arise generically in a broad class of nonperiodic random networks through a simple edge-inflation procedure. Starting from random regular, Voronoi tessellation, Delaunay triangulation, scale-free, small-world, and Erd\"os-R\'enyi seed graphs, each edge is replaced by a finite one-dimensional tight-binding chain, either with fixed length $L$ or with random lengths of mean $\bar L$. Although the original random graphs typically have adjacency matrices of full rank and therefore few or no zero eigenstates, their inflated counterparts exhibit extensive flat bands. The flat-band energies are determined by the eigenstates residing on the chains or, more generally, by the eigenvalues of identical loopless motifs replacing the seed bonds. The corresponding eigenstates are states supported on subsets of the inflated chains formed by destructive interference at the original seed vertices. For zero-energy flat bands, we relate the degeneracy to the graph nullity $\eta(G)$ and the maximum matching number $\nu(G)$. The numerical results support the correspondence $\eta(G)=N-2\nu(G)$, up to small deviations, across the random graph ensembles studied. The fraction of degenerate zero-energy states in inflated random graphs is controlled primarily by the average degree of the seed graph. We further show that the flat bands exhibit characteristic robustness to disorder: disorder on the seed sites and random magnetic flux leave the flat bands essentially unchanged, while bond disorder and disorder on the chain or motif sites broaden them. These results show that flat bands do not require crystalline order, but can emerge as robust consequences of local graph inflation and motif substitution.

AI.tldr: 非周期随机网络通过边膨胀可普遍产生扩展平带；其零能简并与图零度、最大匹配数相关，且对部分无序具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 平带通常与周期晶格中的干涉相消或手性对称约束相关；本文旨在说明平带并不必需晶体序，而可由随机网络的局部边膨胀或基元替换产生。
AI.method: 从随机正则图、Voronoi镶嵌、Delaunay三角化、无标度、小世界和Erdős–Rényi种子图出发，将每条边替换为有限一维紧束缚链（固定长度L或均值L̄的随机长度），或更一般地用相同无环基元替换种子键；分析其谱、简并度、零能态与图零度η(G)及最大匹配数ν(G)的关系，并检验多种无序的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 膨胀后的随机图出现扩展平带，其能量由链或替换基元的本征态决定；对应本征态由种子顶点处干涉相消形成，支持在膨胀链子集上。零能平带简并与η(G)和ν(G)相关，数值支持η(G)=N−2ν(G)（仅有小偏差）；零能简并态比例主要由种子图平均度控制。平带对种子位点无序和随机磁通基本不变，但键无序及链/基元位点无序会使其展宽。
AI.conclusion: 平带不需要晶体序，可作为局部图膨胀和基元替换的鲁棒结果出现在广泛的非周期随机网络中。

title: Steering of topological criticality in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain via non-Hermitian substitutional impurities
summary: We investigate the topological phase in a one-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain in the presence of a finite concentration of non-Hermitian substitutional impurities. Our primary focus is the discovery of a deterministic mechanism to actively reconfigure the topological phase boundaries by introducing site-dependent, non-reciprocal intracell and intercell hopping amplitudes. Specifically, breaking the internal structural symmetry of the non-reciprocal impurity hoppings induces a targeted macroscopic displacement of the critical point. This mechanism allows for the controlled expansion or compression of the topological phase strictly via local defect asymmetry. We validate this boundary displacement through finite-size scaling analysis. The extracted correlation length critical exponents ($\nu \approx 1.455$ and $\nu \approx 1.397$ for symmetric and asymmetric configurations, respectively) confirm a disorder-induced departure from the pristine SSH universality class, with the exponent diverging at high defect densities. We also report an impurity-induced real-to-complex spectral transition geometrically characterized by the Non-Hermitian Skin Effect. Ultimately, our results establish how isolated non-Hermitian asymmetries cooperatively interact to deterministically shift macroscopic topological protection.

AI.tldr: 在一维SSH链中引入有限浓度非厄米替代杂质，并通过破坏非互易杂质跃迁的内部结构对称性，可确定性地宏观移动拓扑相临界点，从而主动扩展或压缩拓扑相。
AI.motivation: 现有研究需要一种确定性机制来主动重构拓扑相边界，而非仅观察杂质或非厄米性带来的被动效应；本文旨在利用局域非厄米缺陷的不对称性实现对宏观拓扑相界的可控调节。
AI.method: 构建含有限浓度非厄米替代杂质的一维SSH链，引入位点依赖的非互易胞内与胞间跃迁振幅；通过打破非互易杂质跃迁的内部结构对称性诱导临界点位移，并用有限尺寸标度分析提取相关长度临界指数，同时分析杂质诱导的实-复谱转变与非厄米趋肤效应。
AI.result: 非厄米杂质跃迁的内部对称性破缺可使拓扑临界点发生定向宏观位移，从而仅通过局域缺陷不对称性控制拓扑相的扩展或压缩；有限尺寸标度给出对称与不对称构型下ν≈1.455和ν≈1.397，表明无序导致偏离原始SSH普适类，且高缺陷密度下指数发散；还观察到由非厄米趋肤效应几何刻画的杂质诱导实-复谱转变。
AI.conclusion: 孤立的非厄米不对称性可协同作用，确定性地移动宏观拓扑保护边界；这为利用局域非厄米缺陷主动调控SSH拓扑相及理解无序、非互易性与拓扑普适类的关系提供了机制。

title: Zeeman Quantum Geometry of the Layer Pseudo-spin
summary: Two-dimensional layers coupled by position-dependent interlayer tunnelling host a layer pseudo-spin whose polarization is a controllable internal degree of freedom. We introduce the quantum geometry of this layer pseudo-spin: a mixed tensor formed from the interband Berry connection and the layer matrix element, which governs the response to an oscillating in-plane electric field. Because the layer pseudo-spin is an Ising-type scalar invariant under threefold rotation, its selection rules differ from those of a pseudovector spin. In a minimal two-band model, the layer-pseudo-spin quantum metric and Zeeman--Berry curvature are nonzero, while their zone integrals vanish. An in-plane drive therefore leaves the spatially averaged polarization unchanged at linear order but imprints a moir\'{e}-periodic intracell pattern, directly imageable by layer-resolved tunnelling. For twisted MoTe$_2$ bilayer, we quantify the local dipole modulation and identify the rectified, helicity-odd, and third-harmonic channels through which a net response appears at higher order.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层赝自旋的量子几何框架，用层间Berry连接与层矩阵元构成的混合张量描述二维莫尔体系对振荡面内电场的响应，并揭示其线性响应仅产生莫尔周期内禀极化图案、净响应需高阶通道。
AI.motivation: 位置依赖层间隧穿耦合的二维层中存在可调控的层赝自旋自由度，但缺乏描述其量子几何及电场响应的统一理论；且层赝自旋为Ising型标量，其选择定则应与赝矢量自旋不同。
AI.method: 构造由带间Berry连接和层矩阵元组成的层赝自旋量子几何混合张量；在最小两带模型中计算层赝自旋量子度规与Zeeman-Berry曲率及其布里渊区积分；对扭转MoTe2双层量化局域偶极调制并分析高阶响应通道。
AI.result: 最小模型中量子度规和Zeeman-Berry曲率非零但区积分消失；面内驱动在线性阶不改变空间平均极化，却印刻可被层分辨隧穿成像的莫尔周期晶胞内图案；在扭转MoTe2中识别出整流、螺旋度奇和三次谐波等高阶净响应通道。
AI.conclusion: 层赝自旋量子几何决定了二维莫尔体系的电场响应选择定则：线性响应主要表现为局域极化调制而非宏观净极化，净响应通过高阶非线性通道出现，为层分辨探测与调控提供依据。

title: Stacking-Induced Tuning of a Flat-Band Surface State in NbIrTe4
summary: Ternary layered transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) offer high tunability and access to correlated and topological states. However, like the broader family of layered TMDCs, their properties are sensitive to stacking order and interlayer coupling. Here, we investigate the electronic structure and surface states of NbIrTe$_4$, a candidate Weyl semimetal in bulk, and predicted to be a quantum spin Hall insulator in monolayer form. Using scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM), angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), and density-functional theory (DFT), we attribute the strong resonance in tunnelling spectroscopy located approximately 8 meV below the Fermi level to a surface-derived flat band which shows sensitivity to the local stacking order at the surface. In regions where the top layer is laterally shifted, tunnelling spectroscopy instead shows a gap-like feature with intensity near the Fermi level shifted in energy. Combining DFT and quasiparticle interference (QPI) measurements, we find this dramatic change in the spectroscopy in the vicinity of the quasi-1D flat-band surface state becomes dispersive due to a change in the spatial distribution of the density of states in the top two layers. These findings establish NbIrTe$_4$ as a platform where surface band dispersion can be effectively tuned through local structural manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文结合STM/STS、ARPES、QPI与DFT研究了三元层状TMDC NbIrTe$_4$的电子结构和表面态，发现其表面平带及近费米能级谱学特征对表面局域堆垛序高度敏感，可通过局部结构操控调节表面能带色散。
AI.motivation: 三元层状过渡金属硫族化合物具有高可调性并可能承载关联态和拓扑态，但其性质强烈依赖堆垛顺序和层间耦合；NbIrTe$_4$块体被预测为Weyl半金属、单层被预测为量子自旋霍尔绝缘体，因此需要厘清其电子结构和表面态。
AI.method: 采用扫描隧道显微镜/隧道谱（STM/STS）、角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）、准粒子干涉（QPI）测量，并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。
AI.result: 在费米能级以下约8 meV处观察到强共振，并将其归因于表面衍生平带，该平带对表面局域堆垛顺序敏感；当顶层发生横向位移时，隧道谱出现带隙样特征且近费米能级强度发生能量移动。DFT与QPI表明，准一维平带表面态附近谱学的显著变化源于顶两层态密度空间分布改变，使该表面态变得具有色散。
AI.conclusion: NbIrTe$_4$可作为通过局部结构操控有效调节表面能带色散的平台。

title: Quantum Oscillations across Hole Crystallization in Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: Recent quantum-oscillation measurements in rhombohedral graphene reveal an abrupt increase in the dominant frequency and the emergence of additional frequencies as the carrier density is lowered toward superconductivity. Noninteracting band models can account for multiple frequencies but do not explain the upward jump. We show that these features can arise from two competing fates of the inner hole pocket in an annular Fermi sea: collapse into a simply connected Fermi liquid or crystallization into an anticrystal, in which localized holes coexist with itinerant electrons. Pocket collapse contracts the outer Fermi contour at fixed density, whereas hole crystallization preserves a larger contour that supports magnetic-breakdown orbits. This contrast provides a possible explanation for the frequency jump, while additional reconstructed orbits produce a multitone spectrum. Our results support the anticrystal as a candidate normal state near superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene.

AI.tldr: 菱形石墨烯中量子振荡频率随载流子密度降低而突增及多频出现，可由环状费米海内孔口袋的两种竞争命运解释：坍缩为单连通费米液体，或晶化为反晶体。
AI.motivation: 非相互作用能带模型虽能解释多频，却无法解释接近超导时主频突然上跳，因此需要寻找能统一解释频率跳变与多音谱的物理机制。
AI.method: 基于环状费米海，分析内孔口袋的两种竞争演化：孔口袋坍缩导致固定密度下外费米轮廓收缩；孔局域化形成反晶体（局域孔与 itinerant 电子共存）并保持较大外轮廓。比较二者对磁击穿轨道和量子振荡频率的影响。
AI.result: 孔口袋坍缩使外费米轮廓收缩；孔晶化则保留较大轮廓并支持磁击穿轨道，从而产生频率跳变，附加重构轨道给出多音谱。
AI.conclusion: 该机制为菱形石墨烯中频率突增和多频结构提供可能解释，并支持反晶体作为超导附近候选正常态。

title: Ballistic transport and crystallographic control in altermagnetic quantum rings
summary: We study coherent two-terminal transport through a finite-width $d$-wave altermagnetic quantum ring with nonmagnetic leads. A confined Aharonov--Bohm flux remains exactly $h/e$ periodic and, in the symmetric one-mode geometry, produces an exact half-flux transmission zero. A perpendicular field shifts the interference pattern according to an effective area $A_{\rm eff}=1.0342\,\pi r_0^2$ and the altermagnetic splitting resolves the common zero into nearby spin-dependent nodes. Rotating the crystal reverses the transmitted spin, whereas the mirror orientation $\theta_A=\pi/4$ is exactly spin degenerate. For a $50$~nm reference ring, sub-tesla fields yield windows with $|P_T|>0.99$, the most accessible of which requires a uniform field alone and no confined flux. Finite-bias, thermal, disorder, Zeeman, and spin-conserving voltage-probe calculations show that the polarization is appreciably more stable than individual coherent-resonance amplitudes. These results identify interference-node positions, flux periodicity, and crystal-controlled spin polarization as experimentally useful signatures of an altermagnetic mesoscopic interferometer.

AI.tldr: 研究了有限宽度d波交错磁量子环与无磁引线耦合的两端相干输运，预言了由阿哈罗诺夫—玻姆相位、晶向和垂直磁场调控的自旋偏振干涉节点。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体兼具自旋分裂与非净磁化特征，需明确其在介观干涉器中可观测的输运特征，尤其是通量周期性、干涉零点和晶体取向控制的自旋偏振。
AI.method: 采用相干两端输运理论，计算有限宽度d波交错磁量子环连接非磁引线时的透射；分析受限阿哈罗诺夫—玻姆通量、垂直磁场、晶向旋转，并进行有限偏压、温度、无序、塞曼项及自旋守恒电压探针计算。
AI.result: 受限通量保持h/e周期性，对称单模几何下出现精确半通量透射零点；垂直场按有效面积A_eff=1.0342πr0^2移动干涉图样，交错磁分裂将共同零点分为邻近的自旋相关节点。旋转晶体可反转透射自旋，镜面取向θ_A=π/4时精确自旋简并。对50 nm参考环，亚特斯拉场即可给出|P_T|>0.99窗口，最易实现者仅需均匀场且无需受限通量；有限偏压、热、无序、塞曼和电压探针计算表明偏振比单个相干共振振幅更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 干涉节点位置、通量周期性和晶体控制的自旋偏振可作为交错磁介观干涉器件的实验可用特征，并显示自旋偏振对非理想条件具有较强鲁棒性。

title: Diffusive Description of Superconducting Single-Photon Detectors Using Quantum Mechanics
summary: The methodology of non-Hermitian quantum mechanics is employed to parameterize the dynamics of coupled classical diffusion equations describing low- and high-energy quasiparticles in superconducting single-photon detectors in one to three spatial dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该文利用非厄米量子力学方法参数化超导单光子探测器中低能和高能准粒子耦合经典扩散方程的动力学，涵盖一至三维空间。
AI.motivation: 旨在为超导单光子探测器中低能和高能准粒子的耦合扩散动力学提供统一、可参数化的描述框架。
AI.method: 采用非厄米量子力学方法，将描述低能和高能准粒子的耦合经典扩散方程进行参数化，并考虑一至三维空间维度。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体定量结果；主要结果是建立了基于非厄米量子力学、适用于一至三维的准粒子耦合扩散动力学的参数化表述。
AI.conclusion: 非厄米量子力学方法可用于参数化超导单光子探测器中多能级准粒子的耦合经典扩散动力学。

title: Magnetic-Field-Induced Darkening of Bright Excitons in a MoWSe$_2$ Monolayer Alloy
summary: Magnetic fields are widely used to brighten spin-forbidden dark excitons, but the inverse effect on an optically bright exciton has remained largely unexplored. We demonstrate the complementary phenomenon of magnetic-field-induced darkening of a bright exciton in Mo$_{0.68}$W$_{0.32}$Se$_2$. At 4.2 K, an in-plane magnetic field up to 25 T activates a dark-exciton line 14.2$\pm$1.3 meV below the bright exciton while suppressing the bright-exciton emission by about 85\%. A bright-dark mixing model quantitatively captures the coupled energy and intensity evolution with an effective in-plane $g$ factor of $|g_{\parallel}|=5.2\pm0.2$. Alloying is crucial to the effect, as it brings the system close to the bright-dark crossover, where a small bright-dark splitting is combined with unusually strong in-plane magnetic coupling. This places the system in a regime where field-induced level repulsion raises the bright-like branch and strongly depletes its thermal population. These results identify a general route to magnetic control of exciton populations through engineering of the bright-dark hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 该工作在Mo0.68W0.32Se2中实现了磁场诱导的亮激子变暗，并观测到暗激子谱线被激活；用亮-暗激子混合模型定量解释了能量与强度随磁场的协同演化。
AI.motivation: 磁场通常用于增亮自旋禁戒的暗激子，但其反向效应——使光学亮激子变暗——此前基本未被探索；作者希望研究亮-暗激子层级可调体系中磁场对激子布居的反向控制。
AI.method: 在4.2 K下对Mo0.68W0.32Se2施加最高25 T的面内磁场，测量亮激子与暗激子的能量和发光强度随磁场的变化，并用亮-暗激子混合模型拟合耦合的能量与强度演化，提取有效面内g因子。
AI.result: 面内磁场激活了位于亮激子下方14.2±1.3 meV的暗激子谱线，同时使亮激子发光抑制约85%；亮-暗混合模型给出|g_parallel|=5.2±0.2，并定量再现能量与强度的耦合演化。合金化使体系接近亮-暗交叉点，具有小亮-暗劈裂和异常强的面内磁耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该效应源于磁场诱导的能级排斥抬升高亮态分支并强烈耗尽其热布居，从而通过调控亮-暗激子层级实现对激子布居的磁控制，提供了一条通用路线。

title: Magnetic-Field Effects on the Electronic States of the K$_4$ Lattice
summary: We investigate the electronic states of the K$_4$ lattice in a uniform magnetic field within a nearest-neighbor tight-binding model. The K$_4$ lattice is a \rev{noncentrosymmetric three-dimensional network with triple-Dirac cones at the $\Gamma$ and H points}. By fixing the Bloch momentum component parallel to the field, the Peierls-substituted tight-binding problem reduces to an effective two-dimensional problem and yields a Hofstadter spectrum \rev{whose self-similar subpatterns reflect the geometry of the lattice projected onto the plane perpendicular to the field}. A square-like substructure emerges on the flux scale $\phi = 1/8$ for $\bm{B}\parallel[100]$, and honeycomb- and triangular-like substructures emerge on the finer scale $\phi = 1/32$ for $\bm{B}\parallel[111]$\rev{. Here $\phi$ is the flux through the elementary plaquette of the projected lattice, and these scales correspond to one flux quantum per projected unit cell. Owing to the screw axes of the chiral K$_4$ network, the field-parallel momentum acts as an additional flux, which, for commensurate values of this momentum, shifts the spectrum along the flux axis and brings the second triple-Dirac cone at the H point into the magnetic spectrum}. In the weak-field limit, we derive the Landau-level structure from a low-energy effective Hamiltonian around the $\Gamma$ point. The three-component nature of the triple-Dirac cone gives rise to a cubic secular equation, whose solutions describe how a pseudospin-flat branch coexists with two relativistic Landau ladders \rev{and a single chiral $n=0$ level dispersing linearly along the field, in agreement with the lattice calculation}.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了均匀磁场下K$_4$晶格的电子态，揭示了由三重狄拉克锥和手性网络导致的Hofstadter谱子结构与异常朗道能级结构。
AI.motivation: 理解非中心对称三维K$_4$网络在磁场中的电子响应，特别是其三重力狄拉克锥、螺旋轴和投影几何如何影响磁谱与朗道量子化。
AI.method: 采用最近邻紧束缚模型并引入Peierls相位；固定平行于磁场的Bloch动量分量，将三维问题约化为有效二维Hofstadter问题；并在弱场下由$\Gamma$点附近低能有效哈密顿量推导朗道能级。
AI.result: 对于$\bm{B}\parallel[100]$，在通量$\phi=1/8$处出现方形子结构；对于$\bm{B}\parallel[111]$，在更细的$\phi=1/32$尺度出现蜂窝状和三角状子结构。螺旋轴使场平行动量等效为附加通量，在公度动量下沿通量轴移动谱并将H点第二三重狄拉克锥引入磁谱。弱场下三重狄拉克锥给出三次久期方程，其解包含一个赝自旋平坦分支、两个相对论性朗道阶梯以及一个沿磁场线性色散的单一手性$n=0$能级。
AI.conclusion: K$_4$晶格的三重狄拉克锥和非中心对称手性结构产生了不同于常规狄拉克材料的Hofstadter子图案与朗道能级谱，其中场平行动量可作为附加通量调控磁谱并连通不同三重狄拉克锥。

title: Collective Hall quantization in 3D Chern vector systems
summary: Understanding the three-dimensional (3D) quantum Hall effect, characterized by a Chern vector rather than a single Chern number, has been a central pursuit in topological physics. While quantized Hall transport is established for the special case with one nonzero Chern component, recent realizations of more general Chern-vector states raise a fundamental question: how does such topology protect quantized transport? Here, we predict a distinct 3D quantized Hall effect protected by $\mathbf{C}=(0,m,n)$. For samples with dimensions $L_y$ and $L_z$, global topology enforces collective quantization of $mL_y+nL_z$, despite the fragility of individual edge modes to disorder. This reveals a novel transport regime in which robust quantization emerges as a holistic property of a unified chiral network,rather than of its constituent modes. Crucially, this collective response manifests as a quantized Hall conductance $G_{xy}=\pm(mL_y+nL_z)e^2/h$, with a distinctive dependence on both Chern-vector components and sample dimensions. We propose candidate materials to facilitate experimental observation.

AI.tldr: 该文预测由陈矢量 C=(0,m,n) 保护的新型三维量子霍尔效应，其霍尔电导按 mL_y+nL_z 集体量子化，而非依赖单个边缘模。
AI.motivation: 三维量子霍尔效应由陈矢量而非单一陈数刻画；已有工作主要确立单个非零陈分量的量子化输运，而更一般陈矢量态如何保护量子化输运尚不清楚。
AI.method: 通过理论分析三维拓扑态与边缘输运，考虑尺寸为 L_y 和 L_z 的样品，研究陈矢量 C=(0,m,n) 下边缘模在无序中的稳定性及整体拓扑约束。
AI.result: 发现全局拓扑强制 mL_y+nL_z 的集体量子化，表现为霍尔电导 G_xy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e^2/h，并同时依赖陈矢量分量和样品尺寸；单个边缘模虽易受无序破坏，但统一手性网络作为整体仍保持稳健量子化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了由统一手性网络整体性质而非组成模式决定的稳健量子化输运新机制，并提出可用于实验观测的候选材料。

title: On the origin of nonreciprocal charge transport in topological insulator BiSbTeSe2
summary: Nonreciprocal charge transport provides an effective approach for probing direction dependent charge dynamics and spin-momentum-locked electronic states. Here, we report highly gate-tunable nonreciprocal charge transport in dual-gated BiSbTeSe2 topological insulator device. The second-harmonic longitudinal resistance is linear in both current and magnetic field. The nonreciprocal response reaches its maximum near the charge neutrality point, exhibits sign reversals on either side, and is strongly suppressed once the Fermi level enters the bulk states. We suggest that the nonreciprocal response is attributed to the inhomogeneity of spin-momentum locking in the topological surface states. The nonreciprocal signal near the charge neutrality point is about one order of magnitude larger than that without gate modulation and remains robust up to 300 K, highlighting BiSbTeSe2 as a promising platform for room-temperature nonlinear electronics.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了双栅BiSbTeSe2拓扑绝缘体器件中高度栅极可调的非互易电荷输运，并观测到二次谐波纵向电阻随电流和磁场线性变化。
AI.motivation: 非互易电荷输运可用于探测方向依赖的电荷动力学和自旋-动量锁定电子态；作者旨在利用栅极调控研究拓扑表面态中的非互易响应，并探索室温非线性电子学应用。
AI.method: 制备双栅BiSbTeSe2拓扑绝缘体器件，测量二次谐波纵向电阻随电流和磁场的变化，并通过双栅调节费米能级位置。
AI.result: 二次谐波纵向电阻对电流和磁场均呈线性；非互易响应在电荷中性点附近达到最大，在两侧发生符号反转，费米能级进入体态后被强烈抑制。作者将其归因于拓扑表面态中自旋-动量锁定的不均匀性。电荷中性点附近的非互易信号比无栅极调制时约大一个数量级，且在高达300 K时仍保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: BiSbTeSe2中的非互易响应源于拓扑表面态自旋-动量锁定的不均匀性，并具有显著栅极可调性和室温稳健性，表明其是室温非线性电子学的有前景平台。

title: Polarity-selective domain wall propagation driven by spin-orbit torque
summary: Spatial variations in magnetic anisotropy impede the spin-orbit-torque-driven motion of chiral domain walls in perpendicularly magnetized nanowires. We show that the local geometry of a two-dimensional anisotropy landscape can select which wall polarity propagates under a given current. Micromagnetic simulations of spatially correlated random anisotropy landscapes generated by diffusion-based smoothing reveal different propagation outcomes for up--down and down--up walls within the same disorder realization. A single inclined anisotropy boundary isolates the mechanism: in the presence of the Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction, opposite wall polarities develop opposite current-induced tilts, producing different alignment with the boundary and hence different pinning strengths. Reversing the boundary inclination interchanges the pinned and propagating polarities. An extended collective-coordinate model captures this geometric selection and distinguishes the propagation threshold from the static pinning limit.

AI.tldr: 空间变化的磁各向异性可依据二维各向异性景观的局部几何选择性决定哪种手性畴壁极性在自旋轨道矩驱动下传播。
AI.motivation: 垂直磁化纳米线中，磁各向异性的空间涨落会阻碍自旋轨道矩驱动的 chiral domain wall 运动；需要理解无序景观如何影响不同畴壁极性的传播。
AI.method: 通过扩散平滑生成空间相关随机各向异性景观并进行微磁模拟，同时用单个倾斜各向异性边界隔离机制，并建立扩展的集体坐标模型。
AI.result: 在同一无序实现中，up-down 与 down-up 畴壁传播结果不同；在 DMI 存在时，相反极性畴壁产生相反电流诱导倾斜，从而与倾斜边界有不同对齐和钉扎强度；反转边界倾角会交换钉扎与传播极性。
AI.conclusion: 二维各向异性景观的局部几何可通过 DMI 诱导的畴壁倾斜选择性决定传播极性，扩展集体坐标模型可描述该几何选择并区分传播阈值与静态钉扎极限。

title: Time-Reversal Symmetry in Artificial Topological Graphene Rings
summary: We study an artificial graphene ring described by the low-energy two-valley Dirac Hamiltonian with a uniform mass term. When the ring is threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm flux, the problem reduces to a second-order radial equation solved by Bessel functions. We give the exact secular equation and, for narrow rings, closed expressions for the spectrum and the persistent current. We then add a uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the plane. The radial problem is solved with confluent hypergeometric functions, and the persistent current and magnetization are written as derivatives of a secular determinant from which the spurious roots have been removed. Besides the usual orbital coupling, the field enters through a valley-dependent term that comes from the Dirac structure and lifts the valley degeneracy. A weak-field expansion, accurate up to corrections of order B^4, gives this valley splitting explicitly and separates the diamagnetic and paramagnetic contributions to the susceptibility. Finally, we work out what time reversal implies for the spectrum. Physical time reversal, which exchanges the valleys, leads to an exact relation between levels at opposite fields. The effective single-valley time reversal, on the other hand, is broken by the mass term and by the boundary conditions, yet leaves no trace in the zero-field spectrum. Numerical results for the spectrum, the persistent current, and the magnetization illustrate the analysis.

AI.tldr: 研究了含均匀质量项的人工石墨烯环：在AB磁通下用Bessel函数求径向问题并给出窄环谱与持续电流；加入垂直磁场后用合流超几何函数、久期行列式和弱场展开分析持续电流、磁化率、谷分裂及时间反演。
AI.motivation: 澄清双谷Dirac环中质量项、AB磁通和垂直磁场如何影响能谱、持续电流与磁化，并区分物理时间反演与有效单谷时间反演的作用。
AI.method: 采用低能双谷Dirac哈密顿量加均匀质量项；AB磁通情形化为Bessel函数求解的二阶径向方程并导出精确久期方程；垂直磁场情形用合流超几何函数求解，借去除伪根的久期行列式表示持续电流和磁化，并作至B^4阶的弱场展开。
AI.result: 窄环给出谱和持续电流的闭式；垂直磁场除轨道耦合外还产生谷依赖项并解除谷简并；弱场展开显式给出谷分裂并分离抗磁与顺磁磁化率贡献；物理时间反演交换谷并给出相反磁场能级的精确关系，而有效单谷时间反演被质量项和边界条件破坏但在零场谱中无痕迹；数值结果展示了谱、持续电流和磁化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了人工石墨烯环在磁通和垂直磁场下的精确与近似解析框架，阐明了谷简并、磁响应和时间反演对称性的联系，并由数值结果验证。

title: Adiabatic confinement and number-theoretic spectra of massless Dirac fermions in twisted trilayer graphene
summary: Electrons in graphene move like massless relativistic particles, making them exceptionally mobile but difficult to trap because Klein tunnelling permits unimpeded passage through electrostatic barriers. This challenge extends to atomic collapse and hadron confinement. Twisted trilayers form Bernal and rhombohedral domains joined by smooth boundaries, bringing their carriers into contact. Here we show that a new mechanism, distinct from established approaches, confines massless fermions in equilateral triangular Bernal domains without mass barriers, bulk gaps or physical edges. Simulations and analytical modeling reveal that massless carriers have no adiabatic continuation into rhombohedral domains, while escape through nonadiabatic coupling to massive carriers is exponentially suppressed by smooth stacking variation. Perfect reflection in the adiabatic limit turns Bernal domains into quantum cavities in a gapless, edgeless metal. Striking density-of-states oscillations encode Eisenstein-integer arithmetic, linking energies and degeneracies to norms and prime factorizations. These findings bring relativistic confinement and number theory into experimentally accessible electronic spectra.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在扭转三层石墨烯的Bernal三角畴中，无需质量势垒、体隙或物理边界即可束缚无质量狄拉克费米子，并预言其态密度振荡编码Eisenstein整数算术。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯中的无质量电子迁移率极高，但Klein隧穿使其可无阻碍穿过静电势垒，因此难以实现相对论性束缚；这一困难也关联原子坍缩和强子禁闭等问题。
AI.method: 利用扭转三层石墨烯形成的Bernal与菱方畴及其平滑堆叠边界，使两类载流子接触；结合数值模拟与解析建模分析无质量载流子在畴间的绝热连续性、非绝热耦合及平滑堆叠变化对逃逸的抑制。
AI.result: 无质量载流子没有进入菱方畴的绝热延续，经非绝热耦合到有质量载流子的逃逸被指数抑制；绝热极限下完全反射使Bernal三角畴成为无隙、无边界金属中的量子腔，态密度振荡呈现Eisenstein整数算术并联系能量、简并度与范数及素因子分解。
AI.conclusion: 该机制实现了无质量费米子的相对论性束缚，并将相对论禁闭与数论映射到可实验访问的电子谱中。

title: Density Saturation and Autocorrelation Characteristics of Interlayer Exciton Ensembles in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ Heterostructures
summary: We investigate interlayer excitons in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterostructures using time-resolved photoluminescence and second-order autocorrelation measurements across a wide range of excitation powers and bath temperatures. By analyzing the photoluminescence amplitude and lifetime of the interlayer exciton state with the lowest emission energy, we extract a corresponding density-temperature diagram. The extracted exciton density exhibits a saturation at approximately $10^{13}$cm$^{-2}$, consistent with values predicted for a Mott transition of interlayer exciton ensembles in van der Waals heterostructures. Moreover, possible interpretations beyond the Mott transition are discussed. We further test whether the density limit is accompanied by a departure from classical photon statistics. The second-order autocorrelation measurements reveal that the photoluminescence maintains an emission characteristic of $g^{(2)}(0) \approx 1$ from low exciton densities up to the maximum reachable density in the investigated exciton ensembles consistent with the lowest-energy exciton ensemble obeying Poissonian statistics.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用时间分辨光致发光与二阶自相关测量，研究MoSe2/WSe2异质结中的层间激子，观察到激子密度在约10^13 cm^-2处饱和，并检验该密度极限是否伴随光子统计偏离。
AI.motivation: 探究范德华异质结中层间激子在高密度下是否发生Mott转变，并判断密度饱和是否伴随从经典光子统计到非经典光子统计的变化。
AI.method: 在不同激发功率和浴温下对MoSe2/WSe2异质结进行时间分辨光致发光和二阶自相关测量；通过分析最低发射能层间激子态的PL幅度和寿命提取密度-温度图，并测量g^(2)(0)。
AI.result: 提取的激子密度在约10^13 cm^-2处饱和，与范德华异质结中层间激子Mott转变的理论预测一致，并讨论了其他可能解释；二阶自相关显示从低密度至可达最高密度g^(2)(0)≈1，符合泊松统计。
AI.conclusion: 密度饱和支持层间激子系综可能发生Mott转变，但光子统计未显示偏离经典泊松统计，表明在该实验范围内密度极限并未伴随可观测的非经典光子统计特征，需谨慎解释Mott转变证据。

title: Steady-state cooperative emission of interlayer excitons in atomically thin light-emitting diodes
summary: When an ensemble of emitters is confined within an optical wavelength, its radiation can become correlated, leading to cooperative emission. In two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) electron-hole bilayers, strong light-matter coupling enables the formation of interlayer excitons (IXs), long-lived dipolar excitations that provide an ideal setting for emergent collective phenomena. Here, we engineer an atomically thin light-emitting diode (LED) that generates electroluminescence (EL) from electrically injected IXs that are confined near the sample edges by an edge-enhanced fringing electric field. By measuring Hanbury-Brown-Twiss photon-photon correlations, we find pronounced signatures of collective decay in the form of large photon bunching followed by finite delay antibunching and bunching revivals. These emitter correlation signatures disappear when free charge carriers are doped to form a degenerate Fermi sea but are enhanced by the introduction of localized electrons. The results are consistent with a many-body quantum master equation that models the steady-state superradiant photon statistics of incoherently injected IXs. Our work establishes steady-state cooperative emission in a 2D TMD LED as a platform for studying strong light-matter interactions in electrically driven, non-equilibrium phases of Bose-Fermi mixtures.

AI.tldr: 作者在二维TMD电子-空穴双层中制备原子级薄LED，利用边缘增强的 fringe 电场将电注入的层间激子限制在样品边缘，并通过HBT关联测量观察到稳态合作辐射。
AI.motivation: 当多个发射体被限制在光波长尺度内时，其辐射可因关联而出现合作发射；二维TMD层间激子寿命长、偶极性强且光-物质耦合强，是研究集体量子现象的理想平台，但电驱动、非平衡条件下的稳态合作发射仍需实现。
AI.method: 构建原子级薄TMD LED，使电注入的层间激子在边缘增强的 fringe 电场作用下局域于样品边缘并产生电致发光；测量Hanbury-Brown–Twiss光子-光子关联，并比较本征、简并费米海掺杂及局域电子引入等条件下的关联特征；用多体量子主方程模拟非相干注入层间激子的稳态超辐射光子统计。
AI.result: 观察到显著集体衰变特征：大光子聚束后出现有限延迟的反聚束与聚束复现；这些发射体关联特征在自由载流子掺杂形成简并费米海时消失，而在引入局域电子时增强；实验结果与多体量子主方程描述的稳态超辐射光子统计一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在二维TMD LED中实现了稳态合作发射，为研究电驱动、非平衡Bose-Fermi混合体系中的强光-物质相互作用提供了新平台。

title: Electronic driving of torsional modes in carbon nanotubes via orbital-phonon coupling
summary: We theoretically investigate electronic driving of a torsional mode in a suspended carbon nanotube quantum dot. The valley states in a nanotube carry opposite orbital magnetic moments along the tube axis, and intervalley mixing forms valley-mixed eigenstates whose splitting can be controlled by an axial magnetic field. We formulate an orbital-rotation coupling between the torsional angular velocity and the valley orbital angular momentum. Using a master equation for sequential tunneling through normal-metal electrodes, we calculate the steady-state current and the phonon distribution of the torsional mode. When the valley-state splitting matches the torsional phonon energy, orbital transitions can drive the mode out of equilibrium. The contacts control both phonon pumping and its electrical readout, allowing substantial excitation with a positive, vanishing, or negative current response. The mechanism requires no intrinsic spin or valley polarization of the electrodes, but uses state-dependent tunneling at the contacts.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究悬浮碳纳米管量子点中扭转模式的电子驱动，利用谷轨道角动量与扭转角速度的耦合，通过顺序隧穿实现声子泵浦与电学读出。
AI.motivation: 探索无需电极本征自旋或谷极化的手段，在纳米机械振子中实现可控的扭转声子激发与探测。
AI.method: 建立谷混合本征态在轴向磁场下可调的模型，提出扭转角速度与谷轨道角动量之间的轨道-旋转耦合，并用正常金属电极顺序隧穿的主方程计算稳态电流与扭转声子分布。
AI.result: 当谷态劈裂与扭转声子能量匹配时，谷轨道跃迁可将扭转模式驱离平衡；电极接触同时控制声子泵浦和电学读出，可实现正、零或负电流响应下的大幅激发。
AI.conclusion: 该机制依赖接触处的态依赖隧穿而非电极自旋/谷极化，为碳纳米管量子点中扭转模式的电学驱动与探测提供了可行方案。

title: Spin-wave circulation in unbounded ferromagnetic film
summary: A key challenge in spin-wave computing is steering spin waves through circuits without wave distortion or reflections. This often results in 1D propagation scenarios, which hinder applicability in 2D magnonic circuits. We demonstrate experimentally a novel approach using a hard magnetic spherical microparticle to guide spin-waves onto a closed path in a plain thin YIG film. The particle stray field induces a radially symmetrical magnetization landscape, which allows spin-waves to loop around. In parallel, we conducted micromagnetic simulations reproducing the experimental conditions, which confirm the circulation of spin-waves over several loops around the particle. This work demonstrates the possibility to steer spin-waves onto a circular path using inhomogeneous magnetic landscape, as well as advancing scalable spin-wave-based information processing technologies.

AI.tldr: 利用硬磁球形微粒的杂散场在YIG薄膜中构建径向对称磁化景观，使自旋波沿闭合圆形路径循环传播。
AI.motivation: 自旋波计算中，引导自旋波时避免波形畸变和反射是关键挑战；常见方案导致一维传播，限制其在二维磁子电路中的应用。
AI.method: 在普通薄YIG薄膜上放置硬磁球形微粒，以其杂散场形成径向对称的非均匀磁化分布来引导自旋波；并开展微磁模拟复现实验条件。
AI.result: 实验观察到自旋波被引导至绕微粒的闭合路径；微磁模拟确认自旋波可绕微粒循环数圈。
AI.conclusion: 证明可利用非均匀磁化景观将自旋波导向圆形路径，为可扩展的自旋波信息处理技术提供新途径。

title: Orbital-angular-momentum control of localized Floquet states and photocurrents in Weyl semimetals
summary: Structured light provides a route to controlling quantum materials not only through its polarization, but also through its spatial profile and orbital angular momentum (OAM). We develop real space theories of a Weyl semimetal driven by a vortex beam and show that optical OAM generates highly localized Floquet vortex states with pronounced circulating photocurrents. Exploiting cylindrical symmetry, we derive a Bogoliubov-de Gennes-like radial equation that resolves the states by angular momentum and reveals their evolution between the light-dressed Weyl cones. For Laguerre-Gaussian beams, the spatially varying drive produces strong hybridization between localized vortex states and bulk states. We complement this continuum description with a Wilson-lattice formulation that retains the full two-dimensional spatial structure and enables direct calculation of local photocurrents. Both approaches consistently identify OAM-induced vortex states localized around the beam axis. The lattice calculation further shows that these states support substantially stronger circulating current densities than the more extended surface states, with the largest current densities associated with the most strongly localized, low-angular-momentum vortex modes. Our results establish optical OAM as a tunable control parameter for creating and manipulating localized current-carrying states in Weyl systems and provide a real-space framework for studying photocurrents generated by spatially structured light.

AI.tldr: 该文用实空间理论研究涡旋光驱动Weyl半金属，发现光学OAM可产生高度局域的Floquet涡旋态和显著循环光电流。
AI.motivation: 结构化光不仅可通过偏振，还可通过空间分布和轨道角动量（OAM）调控量子材料；需要理解涡旋光在Weyl体系中诱导的局域态与光电流。
AI.method: 建立涡旋光束驱动Weyl半金属的实空间理论；利用柱对称性导出类Bogoliubov-de Gennes径向方程，按角动量分解；并用Wilson晶格保留完整二维空间结构以直接计算局域光电流。
AI.result: 两种方法均识别出沿光束轴局域的OAM诱导涡旋态；Laguerre-Gaussian光束下局域涡旋态与体态强杂化；晶格计算表明其循环电流密度显著高于扩展表面态，最强电流密度对应最局域的低角动量涡旋模。
AI.conclusion: 光学OAM可作为可调控制参数，在Weyl体系中产生和操控局域载流态，并提供研究空间结构光致光电流的实空间框架。

title: Quantum Formulation of the Spinterface Model
summary: We present a fully quantum formulation of the spinterface model for the chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect, implemented within the non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism. The model consists of a gold atom hosting a localised magnetic moment, coupled to a chiral molecular chain with Rashba spin-orbit coupling, and contacted by two non-magnetic leads. The magnetic moment is determined self-consistently from the non-equilibrium electronic distribution, and the spin-resolved transmission is computed from the mean-field Hamiltonian. We show that the interfacial magnetic moment and the chiral Rashba term cooperate to produce large current polarisations that reproduce the key experimental signatures of CISS: high polarisation, a threshold emergence at four total sites followed by interference-modulated growth with chain length, thermal suppression, and sign reversal upon chirality inversion. The central new result of this work is a clean separation of the CISS effect into an even (achiral) and an odd (chiral) contribution to the spin current, $I_{S_z}(\phi) = I_{S_z}^{\rm even}(\phi) + I_{S_z}^{\rm odd}(\phi)$. We demonstrate that $I_{S_z}^{\rm odd}$ vanishes exactly at fixed $m_z$ for chains of fewer than four sites and becomes non-zero for chains of four or more sites, with the smallest junction exhibiting a non-zero odd part being the four-site geometry (one gold atom plus three molecular sites). The odd part arises from reciprocity breaking in a device that is simultaneously chiral, magnetically asymmetric (moment on the gold end only), and long enough to support two or more Rashba-active bonds. This provides a direct, parameter-free test of whether an observed spin signal is genuinely chiral or arises from an achiral spin-valve mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该文在NEGF框架下给出CISS效应的全量子spinterface模型：金原子局域磁矩与具有Rashba自旋轨道耦合的手性分子链耦合，并由非平衡电子分布自洽确定磁矩；文章将自旋流分解为偶（非手性）和奇（手性）贡献，证明奇部在少于四个位点时严格为零、四个位点起非零，从而提供区分真手性信号与非手性自旋阀机制的判据。
AI.motivation: CISS实验信号常与界面磁矩、自旋阀效应和分子手性交织，亟需一个可参数无关地区分真正手性自旋输运与非手性机制的量子模型。
AI.method: 构建由局域磁矩金原子、Rashba自旋轨道耦合手性分子链和两个非磁性电极组成的spinterface模型；采用非平衡格林函数形式，自洽求解非平衡电子分布决定的磁矩，并由平均场哈密顿量计算自旋分辨透射。
AI.result: 界面磁矩与手性Rashba项协同产生大电流极化，复现CISS关键实验特征：高极化、四个总位点处阈值出现并随链长干涉调制增长、热抑制以及手性反转时符号反转。核心结果是自旋流可干净分解为I_Sz(φ)=I_Sz^even(φ)+I_Sz^odd(φ)；固定m_z时，少于四个位点的链中奇部严格为零，四个及以上位点非零，最小非零奇部结为四-site几何（一个金原子加三个分子位点）。奇部源于同时具备手性、磁不对称（磁矩仅在金端）且足够长以支持两个及以上Rashba活性键的器件中的互易性破缺。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将CISS效应分解为偶非手性贡献和奇手性贡献，并给出无需拟合参数的手性自旋信号判据：若奇部非零且满足四-site阈值与互易性破缺条件，则信号具有真正手性起源，否则可能来自非手性自旋阀机制。

title: Grain-Boundary Scattering between Chiral Domains in Chiral Topological Semimetal CoSi
summary: We evaluate the electron scattering properties in CoSi thin films having either twin (heterochiral) or non-twin (homochiral) grain boundaries using first-principles quantum transport calculations. We find that scattering across a twin grain boundary is more resistive than scattering across a non-twin grain boundary and that non-twin grain boundaries have a greater percentage of surface conduction than twin grain boundaries. This is corroborated by the transmission eigenstate profiles, which show that the surface Fermi-arc electrons can transmit past the non-twin grain boundaries between homochiral domains on the same surface without significant backscattering. In contrast, these surface electrons get scattered along the twin grain boundaries between heterochiral domains to the opposite surface, resulting in partial forward transmission and partial backscattering that yields higher grain-boundary resistivity. This work helps elucidate the complexities of electron transport in chiral topological semimetals for potential application in next-generation nano-interconnects.

AI.tldr: 在CoSi薄膜中，孪晶（异手性）晶界比非孪晶（同手性）晶界产生更强的电子散射和更高电阻；非孪晶晶界允许表面费米弧电子低背散射透射，而孪晶晶界会将表面电子散射到相反表面，导致部分前向透射和部分背散射。
AI.motivation: 手性拓扑半金属中的晶界手性关系如何影响电子输运尚不清楚，而理解这一点对下一代纳米互连应用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理量子输运计算，比较含孪晶（异手性）与非孪晶（同手性）晶界的CoSi薄膜的电子散射性质，并结合透射本征态分布分析表面费米弧电子的输运行为。
AI.result: 孪晶晶界的散射电阻高于非孪晶晶界；非孪晶晶界的表面导电占比更高。透射本征态表明，表面费米弧电子可在同一表面上同手性畴之间的非孪晶晶界处透射且无明显背散射；而在异手性畴之间的孪晶晶界处，表面电子被散射到相反表面，出现部分前向透射和部分背散射，从而提高晶界电阻率。
AI.conclusion: 晶界的手性匹配关系显著调控CoSi薄膜中的电子散射与表面输运，孪晶/异手性晶界更不利于电子传输；该工作为手性拓扑半金属在纳米互连中的应用提供了微观输运理解。

title: Vortex matter as a magnetically programmable metasurface for tuning near-field radiative heat transfer
summary: Near-field radiative heat transfer (NFRHT) is of great interest for energy conversion and thermal management. Recent work on NFRHT has shown that metasurfaces can enhance NFRHT and reshape its spectral characteristics. Here, we show that the vortex lattice of a type-II superconductor represents a self-assembled metasurface whose lattice dimensions, in contrast to most other metasurfaces, can be tuned by magnetic fields, allowing NFRHT to be varied by orders of magnitude. Specifically, we show that for two Nb surfaces at 4.2 K and separated by a 100 nm gap, NFRHT can be magnetically tuned by a factor >200. Further, we show that the tuning range grows upon cooling, exceeding 10^5 at 2 K, which is far beyond the order-unity modulation of many proposed schemes for tuning NFRHT. Our results establish vortex matter as a magnetically programmable thermal metasurface and open new opportunities for tuning the flow of heat at the nanoscale.

AI.tldr: 该文提出利用II型超导体的涡旋晶格作为自组装、磁可调的超表面，实现对近场辐射热传递（NFRHT）数量级调控。
AI.motivation: NFRHT在能量转换和热管理方面很重要，已有超表面可增强并重塑其光谱特性，但多数方案调控幅度有限，亟需一种可外部编程、调控范围大的NFRHT调控机制。
AI.method: 将II型超导体的涡旋晶格视为自组装超表面，其晶格尺寸可由磁场调节；以4.2 K下间距100 nm的两个Nb表面为例，计算/分析磁场对NFRHT的调控，并考察降温至2 K时的调控范围。
AI.result: 在4.2 K、100 nm间隙的两个Nb表面间，NFRHT可通过磁场调控超过200倍；冷却至2 K时调控范围超过10^5，远大于许多已有NFRHT调控方案的数量级调制。
AI.conclusion: 涡旋物质可作为一种磁可编程的热超表面，为纳米尺度热流调控开辟新途径。

title: Neural Network Fractional Quantum Hall States with Learnable Orbital Pair Matrix Factors: Balancing Physical Priors and Flexibility
summary: Neural network fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states offer a promising alternative for capturing Landau level (LL) mixing and for understanding FQH physics, yet the incorporation of physical priors has so far been limited to the minimal exact constraints built into the ansatz. Working in spherical geometry, we show that the network's flexibility suffers both when only minimal additional physical priors are supplied and when priors such as flux attachment are imposed rigidly. In the former case, the monopole harmonic product orbital (MHPO) ansatz is difficult to optimize, whereas in the latter, the expressivity of the neural network is restricted. We therefore propose the orbital pair matrix factor MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz, which balances physical priors against flexibility by not only replacing the fixed Laughlin structure with learnable pair factors but also making them dependent on both the electron configurations and the orbitals. Across $\nu=1/5$, $1/3$, and $2/5$, MHPO-M achieves the lowest variational energy among the tested variants, and a factorized orbital readout based on it enables scaling to 35 electrons, with energies competitive with trends inferred from three-LL exact-diagonalization results. These results demonstrate that physical priors can be appropriately incorporated without sacrificing the flexibility of neural network wavefunctions, opening a promising path toward accurate, scalable modeling of FQH systems with LL mixing.

AI.tldr: 提出轨道对矩阵因子MHPO（MHPO-M）神经波函数，在球形几何中平衡物理先验与网络灵活性，用于含Landau能级混合的分数量子霍尔态建模。
AI.motivation: 神经分数霍尔态有望刻画Landau能级混合并理解FQH物理，但现有拟函中物理先验的引入局限于最小精确约束；仅加入最小先验时优化困难，刚性施加通量附着等先验又限制网络表达力。
AI.method: 在球形几何下分析MHPO拟函的可优化性与刚性先验的表达力问题，提出MHPO-M：以可学习配对因子替代固定Laughlin结构，并令配对因子同时依赖电子构型与轨道；进一步采用因子化轨道读出以扩展到更多电子。
AI.result: 在ν=1/5、1/3和2/5下，MHPO-M在所测试变体中取得最低变分能量；基于其因子化轨道读出可扩展至35个电子，能量与三Landau能级精确对角化结果推断的趋势具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可适当引入物理先验而不牺牲神经网络波函数灵活性，为准确、可扩展地建模含Landau能级混合的FQH系统提供了有前景的路径。

title: Enhancement of Li and Na Storage in Janus HfSSe Monolayers by Co-Induced Electron-Deficient Chalcogen Sites: A First-Principles Study
summary: The growing demand for high-capacity, fast-charging, and durable rechargeable batteries has intensified the search for advanced electrode materials, with two-dimensional materials offering large surface-to-mass ratios and short ion-diffusion pathways. Here, pristine and Co-doped Janus HfSSe monolayers were investigated as anode materials for Li-ion and Na-ion batteries using first-principles density functional theory. Pristine HfSSe was found to be dynamically stable and exhibited a 0.85 eV band gap, while Co substitution shifted the Fermi level toward the valence-band region. Adsorption of the first Li or Na layer induced metallic behavior, thereby improving charge transport. Co doping strengthened alkali-metal binding, with the most favorable Li and Na adsorption energies changing from -2.6125 and -1.9800 eV to -3.7405 and -3.0529 eV, respectively. Co doping created electron-deficient sites that enhanced Li/Na binding. Co-doped HfSSe accommodated up to four Li layers and three Na layers, increasing the theoretical capacities from 555.43 to 776.19 mAh/g for Li and from 370.29 to 582.14 mAh/g for Na. The average open-circuit voltages were 0.62 V for Li and 0.29-0.30 V for Na, with minimum migration barriers of 0.2153 and 0.1044 eV, respectively. These results identified Co-doped Janus HfSSe as a promising anode material for Li-ion and Na-ion batteries.

AI.tldr: 采用第一性原理DFT研究了本征与Co掺杂Janus HfSSe单层作为Li/Na离子电池负极材料的性能，Co掺杂显著增强了碱金属吸附并提升了理论容量与导电性。
AI.motivation: 高容量、快充、耐久可充电电池需求上升，亟需先进电极材料；二维材料具有大比表面积和短离子扩散路径，因此探索Janus HfSSe及Co掺杂改性作为Li/Na离子电池负极。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理密度泛函理论，计算本征和Co掺杂Janus HfSSe单层的动力学稳定性、电子结构、Li/Na吸附能、金属化行为、层数容纳、理论容量、开路电压及离子迁移势垒。
AI.result: 本征HfSSe动力学稳定，带隙0.85 eV；Co掺杂使费米能级移向价带。首层Li/Na吸附诱导金属性。Co掺杂增强吸附，最优Li/Na吸附能由-2.6125/-1.9800 eV变为-3.7405/-3.0529 eV。Co掺杂HfSSe可容纳4层Li和3层Na，理论容量Li由555.43提升至776.19 mAh/g，Na由370.29提升至582.14 mAh/g；平均开路电压Li为0.62 V，Na为0.29–0.30 V；最小迁移势垒分别为0.2153和0.1044 eV。
AI.conclusion: Co掺杂Janus HfSSe具有增强的Li/Na吸附、较高理论容量、适宜开路电压和低迁移势垒，是有前景的Li/Na离子电池负极材料。

title: GBClaw: An agentic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems hold immense potential for automating complex workflows in materials discovery and design, but extending them to domain-intensive mechanistic investigations remains challenging. Here, we present GBClaw, an agentic AI framework for investigating the structure and deformation of general grain boundaries (GBs). Although general GBs constitute the vast majority of real-world interfaces in polycrystalline materials, they remain understudied because their structural complexity and interfacial mismatch complicate experimental and modeling research. GBClaw integrates large language models (LLMs) into a modular architecture comprising an orchestrator, specialized agents, domain-specific tools, simulation interfaces, and hierarchical memory. Through dynamic replanning and iterative workflow refinement, the framework effectively connects systematic simulations with targeted mechanistic analysis. Applied to 14 general asymmetric tilt GBs in nickel, GBClaw characterized interfacial defect structures and identified diverse deformation modes across these incommensurate boundaries. Comparing boundary sliding with and without secondary GB misfit dislocations revealed substantial differences in shear strength, underscoring the critical role of defect hierarchies in sliding resistance. Furthermore, researcher-guided follow-up calculations traced an anomalously high shear resistance to metastable boundary structures. This work demonstrates that combining agentic AI with domain expertise bridges high-throughput computational screening with deep physical understanding of complex material interfaces.

AI.tldr: 提出 GBClaw——一个面向一般晶界结构与变形研究的智能体 AI 框架，集成大语言模型、专用智能体、领域工具、模拟接口和分层记忆，并在镍的 14 个一般非对称倾斜晶界中实现缺陷结构表征与变形机制分析。
AI.motivation: 一般晶界在多晶材料中占绝大多数，但因结构复杂和界面失配而研究不足；将智能体 AI 扩展到领域密集的机理研究仍具挑战。
AI.method: GBClaw 采用模块化架构，包括 LLM 编排器、专用智能体、领域工具、模拟接口和分层记忆，通过动态重规划和迭代工作流优化连接系统模拟与定向机理分析；应用于镍中 14 个一般非对称倾斜晶界，比较有无二次晶界失配位错时的晶界滑移，并进行研究者引导的后续计算。
AI.result: 表征了界面缺陷结构并识别出多种变形模式；有无二次晶界失配位错导致剪切强度显著差异，表明缺陷层级对滑移阻力关键；异常高剪切阻力被追溯至亚稳晶界结构。
AI.conclusion: 智能体 AI 与领域专业知识结合，可桥接高通量计算筛选与复杂材料界面的深层物理理解。

title: LatticeMind: A Validation-Gated Agentic Framework for Density Functional Theory Workflows
summary: First-principles calculations are rarely single solver calls: they are multistage workflows in which structures, settings, and saved densities must pass correctly between dependent stages. Language models can write a valid single input, but reliability collapses once stages are chained: a dropped dependency, wrong file handoff, or hallucinated keyword can invalidate results even when the solver runs, and such errors surface only after costly execution. We introduce LatticeMind, a validation-gated agentic framework that converts natural-language requests into executable, checkable density functional theory (DFT) projects. A workflow contract specifies required stages, files, and dependencies; deterministic validators inspect the project before any solver launch; failed checks trigger bounded repair; and reports remain traceable to project files. On a 44-case RESCU benchmark spanning total-energy, density-of-states, band-structure, magnetic, phonon workflows, three non-flagship LLM backends reproduced every reference value; 119 of 132 runs passed on the first validated plan and the rest after one repair cycle. Ablations identify the workflow contract and pre-execution validation as the principal reliability mechanisms; a conventional trial-and-repair baseline reaches 71% at twice the token cost per success. The same architecture reproduces every reference value on a 19-case VASP benchmark, demonstrating transfer across solvers. Beyond these task families, LatticeMind generated and validated the 23 inputs of a multistage study of Rh-induced electronic responses at a Rh$_6$/In$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N photocatalyst interface. These results establish workflow contracts, deterministic validation, bounded repair, and traceable records as a practical foundation for reliable AI-assisted scientific computing, where preventable errors are caught before execution and the solver is never the first validator.

AI.tldr: LatticeMind 是一个带验证门控的智能体框架，将自然语言请求转换为可执行、可检查的 DFT 多阶段工作流；通过工作流契约、确定性预执行校验、有限修复和可追溯记录，显著提升链式第一性原理计算的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 第一性原理计算通常是多阶段工作流，结构、设置和保存的电荷密度需在依赖阶段间正确传递。语言模型能生成单个有效输入，但一旦串联阶段，遗漏依赖、错误文件交接或幻觉关键词等错误会在昂贵执行后才暴露，导致结果无效。
AI.method: 提出 LatticeMind：用工作流契约规定必需阶段、文件和依赖；在求解器启动前由确定性校验器检查项目；校验失败触发有界修复；报告可追溯至项目文件。框架将自然语言请求转化为可执行、可检查的 DFT 项目。
AI.result: 在覆盖总能量、态密度、能带、磁性和声子工作流的 44 例 RESCU 基准上，三种非旗舰 LLM 后端均复现所有参考值；132 次运行中 119 次在首个验证计划通过，其余经一次修复周期通过。消融表明工作流契约与预执行验证是主要可靠性机制；传统试错修复基线成功率 71%，但每成功一次 token 成本翻倍。相同架构在 19 例 VASP 基准上复现所有参考值，显示跨求解器迁移；并生成并验证了 Rh6/InxGa1-xN 光催化剂界面 Rh 诱导电子响应多阶段研究的 23 个输入。
AI.conclusion: 工作流契约、确定性验证、有界修复和可追溯记录可作为可靠 AI 辅助科学计算的实用基础：可预防错误在执行前被捕获，求解器不再是第一验证者。

title: Tailoring Dielectric Relaxation and Charge Transport in Amorphous Ge-Te-Se Phase-Change Materials through Yttrium Incorporation
summary: The Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx (x = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15) alloys were prepared by a melt-quenching method and characterized using dielectric spectroscopy. The dielectric parameters and electrical conductivity were evaluated to assess their potential for phase-change memory and other electronic applications. The temperature and frequency dependence of the dielectric constants, ac conductivity, and dielectric loss of prepared chalcogenide glassy alloys were investigated over the frequency range 1 Hz - 1 MHz, and the temperature range 302 - 422 K, below the glass transition temperature. Both dielectric loss and dielectric constant were found to decrease with increasing frequency and decreasing temperature. The observed dielectric loss change was interpreted using the Guintini model of dielectric dispersion, correlated barrier hopping (CBH) model, and orientation polarization. The Cole-Cole analysis confirmed a distribution of relaxation times and yielded activation energies consistent with the CBH conduction mechanism. The frequency dependence of the ac conductivity follows the power law (A{\omega}s), where the frequency exponent (s < 1) decreases with increasing temperature, further supporting the CBH conduction mechanism. The incorporation of Y increases the density of localized tail states, resulting in enhanced ac conductivity. These findings suggest that the investigated materials are promising candidates for future phase-change memory and other electronic device applications.

AI.tldr: 采用熔融淬冷法制备Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx硫系玻璃合金，并通过介电谱研究其介电、弛豫与交流导电行为，评估其在相变存储及电子器件中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 需要评估Te-GeSe-Y基硫系玻璃合金在相变存储和其他电子应用中的潜力，因此研究其介电参数、介电损耗与交流电导率随温度和频率的变化。
AI.method: 用熔融淬冷法制备Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx（x=0.05、0.10、0.15）合金，并在1 Hz–1 MHz、302–422 K（低于玻璃化转变温度）范围内进行介电谱表征；采用Guintini介电色散模型、相关势垒跳跃（CBH）模型和取向极化解释介电损耗，并用Cole-Cole分析弛豫时间分布。
AI.result: 介电常数和介电损耗随频率升高和温度降低而减小；Cole-Cole分析证实存在弛豫时间分布，所得活化能与CBH导电机理一致；交流电导率遵循Aω^s幂律，频率指数s<1且随温度升高而减小，进一步支持CBH机理；Y掺入增加局域尾态密度并提高交流电导率。
AI.conclusion: 该Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx硫系玻璃合金表现出与CBH机制一致的介电和导电行为，Y掺杂可增强交流电导率，因而有望用于未来相变存储和其他电子器件。

title: Heat-current-induced nonreciprocal phonon damping
summary: Time-reversal symmetry enforces equal equilibrium linewidths for time-reversed phonon modes at opposite wave vectors. Here we show that a steady heat current can produce nonreciprocal anharmonic damping even in centrosymmetric nonmagnetic crystals. The effect arises from nonequilibrium occupations of scattering partners, which change the statistical weights of time-reversed three-phonon channels while their squared matrix elements remain equal. Within the single-mode relaxation-time approximation, we derive a linewidth correction that is linear in the temperature gradient and odd under wave-vector reversal. The response depends on scattering-partner velocities and equilibrium lifetimes and retains signed channel weights absent from the equilibrium linewidth. First-principles calculations for centrosymmetric MgO and diamond yield nonzero, mode-dependent linewidth corrections at selected finite wave vectors, demonstrating the mechanism in both ionic and covalent crystals. Reversing the heat current at fixed local temperature exchanges the broadening and narrowing of paired modes. This current-reversible linewidth contrast provides a spectral signature of occupation feedback, with potential implications for nonlinear phonon transport.

AI.tldr: 在中心对称非磁性晶体中，稳态热流可通过非平衡散射伙伴占据改变三声子通道统计权重，产生线性于温度梯度、在波矢反演下为奇的非互易非谐阻尼。
AI.motivation: 时间反演对称性通常要求相反波矢的时间反演声子模式具有相同平衡线宽，因此需要探究热流能否打破这一约束并产生可观测的非互易声子衰减。
AI.method: 在单模弛豫时间近似下推导线宽修正，考虑非平衡占据对时间反演三声子通道统计权重的改变；并对中心对称MgO和金刚石进行第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 线宽修正线性于温度梯度且随波矢反演变号，依赖散射伙伴速度和平衡寿命，并保留平衡线宽中缺失的有符号通道权重；MgO和金刚石在选定有限波矢处给出非零、模式依赖的修正，反转热流会交换成对模式的展宽与窄化。
AI.conclusion: 热流诱导的可逆线宽对比提供了占据反馈的光谱特征，并可能影响非线性声子输运。

title: MOFFieldBench: A Machine Learning Benchmark for Continuous Electronic Fields in Metal-Organic Frameworks
summary: Machine-learning models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) predominantly rely on atomic structures, whereas electron-density (ED) and electrostatic-potential (ESP) fields remain underexplored as scalable learning representations. These continuous fields encode complementary spatial and electronic information relevant to structure-property relationships, particularly pore geometry and guest-framework interactions, but costly first-principles calculations, storage requirements and the scarcity of systematically aligned datasets limit their broader use. Here we introduce MOFFieldBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising approximately 46,000 MOFs with one-to-one aligned crystallographic structures, ED fields and ESP fields. A unified workflow integrates field generation, error-controlled compression and sparse point-cloud representation, supporting field reconstruction, prediction of 13 material properties, multimodal property prediction and pairwise cross-modal retrieval. ED and ESP provide competitive representations for pore geometry, adsorption and separation properties. Multimodal fusion improves several prediction tasks relative to the best unimodal reference, supporting complementary predictive roles for atomic structures and electronic fields. Learned ED reconstruction closely approximates first-principles reference densities, while predicted-density initialization reduces self-consistent-field calculation time by 13.59\% on average in paired tests. These results support electronic fields as practical, informative learning modalities and establish MOFFieldBench as a resource for studying representation choice, multimodal learning and electronic-field-driven MOF modelling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MOFFieldBench，一个约含46,000个MOF的多模态基准，提供一一对齐的晶体结构、电子密度（ED）场和静电势（ESP）场，并系统评估电子场作为可扩展学习表征的价值。
AI.motivation: MOF机器学习主要依赖原子结构，ED和ESP等连续场虽能编码孔道几何与客主相互作用等信息，但受限于昂贵的第一性原理计算、存储需求及缺乏系统对齐数据集，尚未被充分利用。
AI.method: 构建统一工作流，集成场生成、误差控制压缩和稀疏点云表示；支持场重构、13种材料性质预测、多模态性质预测及成对跨模态检索，并在约46,000个MOF上开展基准测试。
AI.result: ED和ESP在孔道几何、吸附与分离性质上具有竞争力；多模态融合在若干预测任务上优于最佳单模态基线；学习到的ED重构接近第一性原理参考密度，且预测密度初始化在配对测试中平均减少13.59%的SCF计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 电子场是实用且信息丰富的学习模态；MOFFieldBench为研究表征选择、多模态学习和电子场驱动的MOF建模提供了资源。

title: An efficient approach to electron-phonon coupling calculations of heterostructures within an all-electron framework
summary: A major challenge in calculating electron-phonon coupling at interfaces from first principles is the prohibitive computational cost due to the large supercells involved. Here, we present an efficient approach, which builds the electron-phonon matrix of weakly bound heterostructures from the properties of the isolated layers. The two key ingredients, the dynamical matrices and the potential response, are constructed in two steps. In the expansion step, these quantities are folded from the unit cells onto the supercell through an exact Fourier mapping. In the addition step, the interatomic force constants and the potential responses of the heterostructure are assembled blockwise from the corresponding quantities of the isolated layers, neglecting the weak interlayer contribution. The method is implemented in the electron-phonon module of the all-electron full-potential code exciting, enabling efficient calculations of the electron-phonon self-energy. We demonstrate the approach for the phonon dispersion and spectral functions of bilayer WSe$_2$ and pyridine/MoS$_2$, in comparison with exact reference calculations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从孤立层性质构建弱束缚异质结电子-声子矩阵的高效第一性原理方法，并在 bilayer WSe2 与 pyridine/MoS2 中验证。
AI.motivation: 界面电子-声子耦合的第一性原理计算因涉及大超胞而计算成本过高，亟需低成本且准确的替代方案。
AI.method: 将孤立层的动力学矩阵和势响应通过精确傅里叶映射从单胞折叠到超胞，并忽略弱层间贡献，分块组装异质结的原子间力常数与势响应；方法实现于全电子全势代码 exciting 的电子-声子模块，用于计算电子-声子自能。
AI.result: 对 bilayer WSe2 和 pyridine/MoS2 的声子色散与谱函数进行了计算，并与精确参考结果比较，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方案可高效构建弱束缚异质结的电子-声子耦合矩阵，为界面电子-声子自能计算提供可行途径。

title: Nanoscale chemical engineering of Ti3C2Tx MXene multilayers through in situ electron beam irradiation in a TEM
summary: Defect engineering in low-dimensional materials is a powerful approach to tailor their structure and chemistry at the atomic scale, with high relevance for tuning physical properties. Here, we apply this strategy to MXenes, one of the largest families of two-dimensional (2D) materials, and demonstrate the use of a highly focused scanning transmission electron microscope (STEM) beam for the structural and chemical nanoengineering of titanium carbide (Ti3C2Tx) multilayers. By adjusting the beam energy, electron dose, and scanning parameters, Ti3C2Tx multilayers were irradiated at 80 and 300 keV and characterized in situ using annular dark-field imaging and electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS). The irradiation induces gradual structural and chemical modifications, largely driven by the selective sputtering of atomic species and MXene layers. We identify irradiation conditions that selectively remove Cl or F surface terminations while largely preserving the Ti3C2 framework, whereas other conditions promote preferential carbon removal, in agreement with theoretical predictions. Most notably, electron irradiation drives the migration and accumulation of initially dilute nitrogen impurities within the irradiated regions, leading to the formation of nitrogen-rich titanium carbonitride (Ti3CyNzTx) nanodomains embedded in the Ti3C2Tx multilayers. These laterally patterned carbide/carbonitride architectures constitute in-plane MXene heterostructures with nanometer-scale spatial control. These results demonstrate that electron irradiation can be used to locally tailor MXene composition and create nanoscale architectures beyond those accessible through conventional chemical synthesis.

AI.tldr: 利用聚焦STEM电子束对Ti3C2Tx多层MXene进行原位辐照，通过调节束能、剂量和扫描参数，实现选择性去除表面终止基团、优先脱碳以及氮杂质迁移聚集，形成纳米尺度Ti3CyNzTx碳氮化物畴和面内MXene异质结构。
AI.motivation: 低维材料缺陷工程可在原子尺度调控结构与化学性质；MXene的局部组成调控和纳米图案化受常规化学合成能力限制，需要可控的电子束纳米工程策略。
AI.method: 在80和300 keV下对Ti3C2Tx多层进行STEM辐照，改变束能、电子剂量和扫描参数；采用环形暗场成像和电子能量损失谱进行原位表征，并结合理论预测分析选择性溅射与化学改性。
AI.result: 辐照引起渐进的结构的化学修饰，主要由原子物种和MXene层的选择性溅射驱动；特定条件可选择性去除Cl或F终止而基本保留Ti3C2骨架，其他条件则优先去除碳；电子辐照促使稀薄氮杂质迁移并聚集，在辐照区形成富氮Ti3CyNzTx纳米畴并嵌入Ti3C2Tx中，构成纳米级面内MXene异质结构。
AI.conclusion: 电子辐照可局部定制MXene组成并构筑常规化学合成难以实现的纳米级架构，为MXene缺陷工程和面内异质结构制备提供了有效途径。

title: Reaction-induced Localized Annealing for On-chip Materials Discovery
summary: On-chip thermal processing is a key technology for materials discovery across all disciplines of the natural sciences. Here, we present a microfabricated heat-delivery platform that enables reaction-induced localized on-chip annealing up to 1400{\deg}C. A buried reactive multilayer combined with a nanometric diffusion barrier provide ultra-fast heating and quenching rates on the order of 10$^6${\deg}C s$^{-1}$ as illustrated by the generation of ultra-high aspect ratio microstructures during rapid-solidification and the stabilization of dopant-free tetragonal zirconia at room temperature. Rapid kinetics also enable the observation of transient states of capillary-driven hole collapse in melts. Our work expands localized high-temperature processing routes and offers a material-independent approach for rapid screening of multidimensional nanomaterials on and off-equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 提出一种微加工片上热输送平台，利用埋入式反应多层与纳米扩散屏障实现最高1400°C、约10^6°C/s的超快局部退火与淬火，并用于非平衡材料制备与瞬态过程观测。
AI.motivation: 片上热加工是跨学科材料发现的关键技术，但需要实现局部高温、超快升降温并适用于多种材料体系。
AI.method: 构建微加工热输送平台：将反应性多层埋入芯片，并结合纳米级扩散屏障，通过反应诱导实现局部片上退火，支持超快加热和淬火。
AI.result: 该平台实现最高1400°C退火和约10^6°C/s升降温速率；在快速凝固中生成超高长径比微结构，在室温稳定无掺杂四方氧化锆，并观察到熔体中毛细驱动孔塌缩的瞬态状态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作扩展了局部高温加工路径，并提供一种材料无关的方法，用于在平衡与非平衡条件下快速筛选多维纳米材料。

title: Fully Automated Wannier Disentanglement via Projectability Selection in Gaussian and Augmented Plane-Wave Frameworks
summary: Constructing the frozen manifold for entangled bands requires balancing exact reproduction of the target bands with sufficient variational freedom to build a well-localized subspace from the broader Bloch pool. We present a workflow that systematically determines the energy ceiling for a target number of selected Wannier projections, freezing every Bloch state below this threshold across the sampled k-mesh. By measuring projectability, the spectral weight of each Bloch state projected onto the target localized basis, the workflow detects missing conduction channels and quantifies discrepancies between orbital character and energy-based freezing. In comparisons where we controlled the extent of the energy ceiling, freezing all sub-ceiling states is generally favored over projectability-based frozen states. Of the seven materials we tested, freezing all sub-ceiling states lowers the band error on four from between 11 meV and 1.2 eV to 18 meV or less, and matches the projectability-based choice to within about 2 meV on the remaining three. In each of the four, projectability-based frozen states give the lower spread, showing that spread alone cannot identify the better model. With the frozen states held fixed, the workflow minimizes the gauge-invariant spread, constructs the gauge from density-matrix columns on atomic orbitals, and passes an isolated set of bands to Wannier90 for localization. The workflow is implemented in two programs for seamless high-throughput Wannierization with WIEN2k (wien2wannier) and CRYSTAL (LCAO2Wannier). Using a single set of calibrated defaults, the CRYSTAL implementation with analytic overlaps produces models that reproduce the reference bands of five cells, from bulk h-BN in a joint valence-and-conduction model to a magnetic framework with 1424 orbitals. The WIEN2k implementation produces eight such models from seven calculations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种系统化冻结纠缠能带中Bloch态并构建局域Wannier流形的流程，通过能量上限与projectability评估确定冻结策略，并在WIEN2k和CRYSTAL中实现高通量Wannierization。
AI.motivation: 纠缠能带的冻结流形需在精确复现目标能带与保留足够变分自由度以获得良好局域子空间之间权衡；现有选择缺乏系统判据，且高吞吐Wannier化需要可复用的默认流程。
AI.method: 对给定数量的目标Wannier投影系统确定能量上限，冻结采样k网格中所有低于阈值的Bloch态；用projectability衡量Bloch态在目标局域基上的谱权重，检测缺失导带通道并量化轨道特征与能量冻结的差异；固定冻结态后最小化规范不变spread，由原子轨道密度矩阵列构造规范，并将隔离能带传给Wannier90局域化；实现为wien2wannier和LCAO2Wannier。
AI.result: 在7个材料中，冻结所有低于能量上限态使4个材料的能带误差从11 meV–1.2 eV降至≤18 meV，其余3个与基于projectability的选择相差约2 meV以内；4个改进材料中projectability冻结态的spread更低，说明spread本身不能判定更优模型。CRYSTAL实现用单套校准默认参数复现5个胞参考能带，包括h-BN价带-导带联合模型和含1424个轨道的磁性框架；WIEN2k实现从7个计算得到8个模型。
AI.conclusion: 冻结全部低于能量上限的Bloch态通常是更稳健的默认策略；spread不能单独用于模型选择；该流程可实现与WIEN2k和CRYSTAL无缝衔接的高吞吐Wannierization。

title: Learning the Geometry of Materials Space with Trained Neural Tangent Kernels
summary: Neural networks trained to predict materials properties learn representations whose physical content can be difficult to extract. We use the neural tangent kernel (NTK), evaluated at trained parameters, to recover the geometry learned by a network that predicts superconducting transition temperatures from elemental composition alone. Kernel ridge regression with the trained NTK closely reproduces the network's predictive performance and substantially outperforms regression with the initial kernel. Spectral analysis and multidimensional scaling reveal a geometry dominated by a small number of directions. Clustering and local neighborhood analysis organize compounds into recognizable superconducting families and connect materials with related chemical and correlated-electron properties despite substantial differences in $T_c$. These results establish trained tangent kernels as practical probes of learned materials representations, connecting property prediction with the exploration of materials space.

AI.tldr: 该文用训练后的神经正切核（NTK）探测仅凭元素组成预测超导转变温度的网络所学表征几何。
AI.motivation: 神经网络能学习材料性质预测表征，但其物理内容难以提取；作者希望用NTK揭示网络学到的材料空间几何结构。
AI.method: 在训练参数处评估NTK，并用核岭回归检验其预测性能；结合谱分析、多维标度和局部邻域/聚类分析研究表征几何。
AI.result: 训练后NTK的核岭回归接近网络预测性能并显著优于初始核；表征由少数方向主导，聚类和局部邻域能组织出可识别的超导家族，并连接化学性质及相关电子性质相近但Tc差异较大的材料。
AI.conclusion: 训练后的切核可作为探测材料学习表征的实用工具，将性质预测与材料空间探索联系起来。

title: In Situ Thermal Preparation by CO$_2$-Laser and Chemical Characterization of Oxide Substrates Across Multiple Crystallographic Orientations
summary: Atomically flat and chemically controlled oxide substrate surfaces are essential for high-quality epitaxial growth of complex materials and heterostructures. Previous studies have demonstrated in situ thermal preparation of selected oxide substrates, primarily focusing on conventional low-index orientations such as SrTiO$_3$ (100) and LaAlO$_3$ (100). Here, we extend these methodologies to a broader range of oxide substrates and crystallographic orientations, including challenging polar surfaces. We present a systematic study of the in situ thermal preparation of SrTiO$_3$ (100), SrTiO$_3$ (111), GdScO$_3$ (110), LaAlO$_3$ (111), (LaAlO$_3$)$_{0.3}$(Sr$_2$AlTaO$_6$)$_{0.7}$ (001), and NdGaO$_3$ (110) single crystal substrates. The substrates are annealed in a vacuum chamber under a controlled oxygen background environment using a CO$_2$ laser heating system. The optimized annealing conditions produce atomically flat step-and-terrace structures, long-range surface crystallinity, and effectively clean surfaces across all the investigated substrates. Our results establish a versatile, reproducible, and broadly applicable platform for the in situ preparation of oxide substrates immediately prior to epitaxial growth. These results also provide practical guidelines for interface engineering and surface-sensitive investigations of complex materials.

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究了多种氧化物单晶衬底的原位热退火制备，并证明优化条件可在包括极性表面在内的不同晶向获得原子级平整、洁净且结晶良好的表面。
AI.motivation: 高质量外延生长和异质结构构建依赖原子级平整、化学可控的氧化物衬底表面；已有工作多局限于SrTiO3(100)和LaAlO3(100)等低指数常规表面，需拓展到更广衬底和晶向并解决极性表面制备难题。
AI.method: 对SrTiO3(100)、SrTiO3(111)、GdScO3(110)、LaAlO3(111)、LSAT(001)和NdGaO3(110)单晶衬底进行系统原位热退火；在真空腔中通过CO2激光加热并控制氧背景环境，优化退火条件。
AI.result: 优化退火条件使所有研究的衬底均获得原子级平整的台阶-平台结构、长程表面结晶性和有效洁净的表面。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了通用、可重复且广泛适用的氧化物衬底原位制备平台，可在外延生长前直接使用，并为界面工程和复杂材料表面敏感研究提供实践指南。

title: Nanocrystalline cubic boron arsenide growth on GaAs(100) by gas source molecular beam epitaxy
summary: Cubic boron arsenide (c-BAs) is a promising ultrahigh thermal conductivity semiconductor, but its direct synthesis on lattice-mismatched substrates remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate the synthesis of nanocrystalline c-BAs thin films on GaAs(100) substrates using gas source molecular beam epitaxy. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals an optimal growth temperature window of 250-400 C to maintain near stoichiometry and suppress severe arsenic loss. Surface and structural characterizations via atomic force microscopy, reflection high-energy electron diffraction, and grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction demonstrate a Volmer-Weber 3D island growth mode and a preferential crystallographic alignment with the GaAs substrate. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy confirms a chemically sharp interface without gallium interdiffusion into the c-BAs layer. These findings establish an initial step for the integration of c-BAs into advanced thermal and optoelectronic platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文利用气源分子束外延在GaAs(100)衬底上合成纳米晶立方砷化硼（c-BAs）薄膜，并确认其生长模式、取向关系和界面质量。
AI.motivation: c-BAs具有超高导热潜力，但在晶格失配衬底上直接合成困难，亟需实现其与现有半导体平台的集成。
AI.method: 采用气源分子束外延生长c-BAs/GaAs(100)薄膜；用XPS确定250–400 C为近化学计量比且抑制砷流失的最佳生长窗口；结合AFM、RHEED、掠入射XRD和HRTEM表征形貌、结构及界面。
AI.result: 获得纳米晶c-BAs薄膜，呈现Volmer-Weber三维岛状生长，并与GaAs衬底具有择优晶体取向；HRTEM显示界面化学 abrupt，且无Ga互扩散进入c-BAs层。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了在晶格失配GaAs衬底上直接生长c-BAs薄膜的可行性，为c-BAs集成到先进热管理与光电子平台迈出初始一步。

title: Charge-conserving creation and annihilation of topological phase singularities in atomically thin semiconductors
summary: Atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a promising material platform for optical phase manipulation, as rapid variations in their dielectric functions can give rise to topological phase singularities (PSs). However, PS evolution while preserving topological charge conservation has not yet been investigated in exciton enabled PS systems. Here, using atomically thin MoS2 films on sapphire as a model system, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that the evolution of dielectric dispersion determines the creation, trajectory, merging, and annihilation of optical PSs under topological charge conservation. By varying the MoS2 film thickness, we experimentally realize this evolution through the gradual shrinking of the high energy n-k dispersion loop, which modifies its intersection with the zero reflection condition. Our results provide a general strategy for exploring and manipulating topological optical states.

AI.tldr: 在蓝宝石衬底上的原子级薄MoS2中，介电色散演化在拓扑荷守恒下驱动光学相位奇点的产生、轨迹变化、合并与湮灭；通过改变MoS2厚度使高能n-k色散环逐渐收缩，可实现实验调控。
AI.motivation: 原子级薄过渡金属硫族化合物因介电函数快速变化可产生拓扑相位奇点，但激子参与的光学相位奇点系统中，其演化及拓扑荷守恒尚未被研究。
AI.method: 以蓝宝石上原子级薄MoS2为模型体系，结合理论与实验，通过改变MoS2薄膜厚度调控介电色散，并追踪高能n-k色散环与零反射条件交点的演化。
AI.result: 实验实现高能n-k色散环逐渐收缩并改变其与零反射条件的交点，从而调控光学相位奇点的创生、轨迹、合并和湮灭，同时保持拓扑荷守恒。
AI.conclusion: 介电色散演化决定拓扑荷守恒下光学相位奇点的演化；厚度调控为探索和操纵拓扑光学态提供了通用策略。

title: Accelerating real-time hybrid-functional calculations with learned ACE and symmetry-based FFT reuse
summary: Real-time hybrid-functional calculations require repeated reconstruction of nonlocal exchange, whose cost grows rapidly with Brillouin-zone sampling. We develop two methods to improve the efficiency of time evolution and spatial processing. The first learns the time evolution of adaptively compressed exchange (ACE) factors and predicts their updates, reducing the frequency of explicit reconstruction. The second uses crystal symmetry to reuse exchange fast Fourier transforms (FFTs) among equivalent real-space points. This symmetry-based FFT reuse (SBFR) reduces the number of FFTs while retaining the full $\bm k$-point sum. The methods can be used with a variety of hybrid functionals, and we use HSE06 in this work. Relative to an ACE reference using full-row mesh FFTs, learned prediction provides more than fivefold acceleration, SBFR more than fourteenfold, and their combination more than sixty-threefold. The combined method shows efficient parallel scaling. After learning, propagation takes less than 0.5 s per step. The reduced computational cost allows us to study nonlinear and nonequilibrium electron dynamics with hybrid functionals and to examine the role of excitonic effects in semiconductors and insulators.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出两种加速实时杂化泛函计算的方法：学习预测自适应压缩交换（ACE）因子的时间演化以减少显式重构，以及利用晶体对称性在等价实空间点间复用交换FFT（SBFR）。与使用全行网格FFT的ACE参考相比，二者分别加速超过5倍和14倍，结合后超过63倍，并保持良好并行扩展性。
AI.motivation: 实时杂化泛函计算需要反复重构非局域交换，其成本随布里渊区采样迅速增长，限制了非线性及非平衡电子动力学的杂化泛函模拟。
AI.method: 方法一学习ACE交换因子的时间演化并预测其更新，从而降低显式重构频率；方法二利用晶体对称性在等价实空间点之间复用交换FFT，减少FFT数量，同时保留完整k点求和。两种方法适用于多种杂化泛函，本文采用HSE06。
AI.result: 相对于使用全行网格FFT的ACE参考，学习预测加速超过5倍，SBFR加速超过14倍，二者结合加速超过63倍；组合方法显示高效并行扩展性，学习后每步传播少于0.5秒。
AI.conclusion: 显著降低的计算成本使杂化泛函可用于研究非线性与非平衡电子动力学，并考察半导体和绝缘体中的激子效应。

title: Atomic identification via the Prandtl-Tomlinson stick-slip mechanism
summary: Distinguishing atomic species is an ongoing challenge in the field of scanning probe microscopy. Typically, atomic force microscopy makes use of electrostatic interactions to perform atomic identification. Here we perform lateral force microscopy (LFM) measurements with a CO terminated tip of a partially oxidized Cu(110) surface and show clear differences between the metal and oxygen sites over a large z-range. This allows for atomic identification on a typical metal oxide. Density functional theory based calculations show that the tip-sample interaction is dominated by short-ranged orbital interactions and that the electrostatic contribution is negligible. At small tip-sample distances, LFM can probe the Prandtl-Tomlinson stick-slip mechanism on the single-atom scale. It is visible as a striking asymmetry in the forward and backward scan directions, experimentally revealing this fundamental model for nanotribology on the single-atom scale.

AI.tldr: 该文利用CO末端针尖对部分氧化的Cu(110)表面进行横向力显微镜测量，发现金属位与氧位在大z范围内具有明显差异，从而实现金属氧化物表面的原子识别；DFT表明针尖-样品相互作用主要由短程轨道相互作用主导，静电贡献可忽略。
AI.motivation: 扫描探针显微镜中区分原子种类仍是挑战，原子力显微镜通常依赖静电相互作用进行原子识别，因此需要发展不依赖静电、可在金属氧化物上实现原子识别的机制。
AI.method: 对部分氧化的Cu(110)表面使用CO末端针尖开展横向力显微镜（LFM）测量，并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算分析针尖-样品相互作用及LFM响应。
AI.result: LFM在较大z范围内清晰区分金属位与氧位；DFT显示相互作用由短程轨道相互作用主导、静电贡献可忽略；在小针尖-样品距离下，LFM可在单原子尺度探测Prandtl-Tomlinson粘滑机制，表现为正反向扫描的显著不对称。
AI.conclusion: LFM可用于典型金属氧化物表面的原子识别，并在单原子尺度实验揭示了Prandtl-Tomlinson模型；其原子识别与摩擦响应主要源于短程轨道相互作用而非静电作用。

title: Early-stage local melting during solid-state sintering of a Cu-Ni-Ti-Zr-Hf alloy: A combined thermodynamic and kinetic analysis
summary: Complex concentrated alloys (CCAs) combining elements from 3d transition and refractory groups, specifically Cu-Ni-Ti-Zr-Hf-based shape memory systems, exhibit excellent functional properties but present significant manufacturing challenges via powder metallurgy. In this study, a non-equimolar Cu15Ni35Ti25Zr12.5Hf12.5 (at. %) alloy was successfully produced by induction melting, followed by atomization and subsequent consolidation via Spark Plasma Sintering (SPS) at temperatures ranging from 850 to 1100 C. Although global equilibrium phase diagrams predict solid-state stability up to 1260 C, localized melting unexpectedly occurred during SPS at 1100 C. By combining retrospective Scheil-Gulliver solidification simulations with 2D local equilibrium heat maps, we demonstrate that this early-stage melting is not driven by macroscopic thermal gradients, but by microsegregation inherited from atomization. During solid-state heating, thermally activated short-range diffusion, accelerated by high defect densities at particle interfaces, partitions Ti towards the interparticle network, leaving Cu-enriched regions (up to ~41 at. %) within the particle interiors. Owing to the strongly negative mixing enthalpy of Cu with Hf (-19.2 kJ/mol for $\Delta H_{mix}^{l-l}$) and, to a lesser extent, with Ti, the local solidus of these Cu-rich regions is dramatically depressed. Upon heating to 1100 C, these regions cross their local solidus and form a liquid phase, whose solidification produces the Cu-Hf co-segregation. This framework accounts for localized melting phenomena in rapidly solidified CCA powders containing low-melting constituents with strong negative mixing enthalpies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Cu15Ni35Ti25Zr12.5Hf12.5复杂浓缩合金粉末经SPS固结时在1100 °C发生局部熔化的机制，指出其源于雾化继承的微观偏析而非宏观热梯度。
AI.motivation: 该类3d过渡族与难熔元素组成的Cu-Ni-Ti-Zr-Hf基形状记忆复杂浓缩合金功能性能优异，但粉末冶金制造困难，尤其SPS固结中会出现低于平衡固相线温度的异常局部熔化，需要阐明其机理。
AI.method: 采用感应熔炼、雾化制粉及850–1100 °C放电等离子烧结（SPS）制备非等原子比Cu15Ni35Ti25Zr12.5Hf12.5合金；结合回溯性Scheil-Gulliver凝固模拟与二维局部平衡热图，分析局部熔化原因及元素扩散偏析行为。
AI.result: 平衡相图预测固态稳定至1260 °C，但SPS在1100 °C即发生局部熔化；该现象并非宏观热梯度驱动，而是雾化遗留的微观偏析所致。固态加热时，颗粒界面高缺陷密度加速短程扩散，使Ti向颗粒间网络分配，颗粒内部形成Cu富集区（可达约41 at.%）；Cu与Hf的强负混合焓（ΔH_mix^{l-l}为-19.2 kJ/mol）及较弱的Cu-Ti负混合焓显著降低这些Cu富集区的局部固相线，加热至1100 °C时越过局部固相线形成液相，凝固后产生Cu-Hf共偏析。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了快速凝固复杂浓缩合金粉末中因低熔点组分与强负混合焓元素局部富集而诱发局部熔化的解释框架，强调微观偏析和界面扩散对SPS固结行为的关键影响。

title: Crucial role of magnetic dipole and anomalous field dependence in $\mathrm{NiPS_3}$
summary: $\mathrm{NiPS_3}$ has attracted considerable attention, yet the origin of its intriguing magnetic behaviors remains elusive due to limited insight into its low-energy anisotropy. Here, high-field torque magnetometry measurements are performed, revealing a previously unrecognized anisotropic spin response that reflects interaction terms beyond the standard XY or XXZ models. In combination with relativistic density functional theory calculations and magnetic force response theory, an effective low-energy spin Hamiltonian is constructed, elucidating not only the observed anomalous magnetic behavior but also other recent experiments. Remarkably, the magnetic dipole interaction and the associated spin-flop transition play a crucial role in driving the deviation from two-dimensional spin alignment, providing direct insight into the underlying anisotropic energy hierarchy. The generalized Hamiltonian can serve as the important fundamental ground for future study, and our approach adopted here will hopefully be relevant to many other related material systems.

AI.tldr: 通过高场扭矩磁力测量结合相对论密度泛函理论计算与磁力响应理论，构建了NiPS3的有效低能自旋哈密顿量，揭示其超出标准XY/XXZ模型的各向异性自旋响应，并阐明磁偶极相互作用及自旋翻转转变对偏离二维自旋排列的关键作用。
AI.motivation: NiPS3的磁性行为来源尚不明确，尤其是对其低能各向异性的认识有限。
AI.method: 采用高场扭矩磁力测量，结合相对论密度泛函理论计算和磁力响应理论，构建有效低能自旋哈密顿量。
AI.result: 发现先前未识别的各向异性自旋响应，反映超出标准XY或XXZ模型的相互作用项；所构建的有效哈密顿量不仅解释观测到的异常磁行为，也解释其他近期实验；磁偶极相互作用及相关自旋翻转转变在驱动偏离二维自旋排列中起关键作用，揭示其各向异性能量层级。
